Coram : Sri Ananda Sen, J.
------
For the Petitioner(s) : Mr. Rajiv Kr. Karan, Advocate.

For the State : Mrs. Anuradha Sahay, A.P.P.
.........
04/16.05.2024:

The petitioner is praying for grant of bail as he is in custody for allegedly committing offence punishable under Sections 376(2)(n)/506/313/34 of IPC, in connection with B.S. City (Mahila) Police Station Case No.18 of 2023, corresponding to S.T. Case No.38/2024,
pending in the Court of the learned District & AddI. Sessions Judge-IV, Bokaro.
Heard, learned counsel for the petitioner, learned counsel for the State and have also gone through the impugned order.
I have gone through the First Information Report.
The victim-girl is aged about 21 years.
She says that since last eight years they were having relationship and on the pretext of marriage, the physical relationship developed and now the petitioner has refused to marry her.
Learned counsel for the State has opposed the prayer for bail.
Considering the age of the victim and the fact that they were in relationship since last eight years, I am inclined to grant bail to the petitioner.

Accordingly, the petitioner, named above, is directed to be released on bail on furnishing bail bond of Rs.10,000/- (Rupees Ten Thousand) with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of the learned District & AddI. Sessions Judge-IV, Bokaro in connection with B.S. City (Mahila) Police Station Case No.18 of 2023, corresponding to S.T. Case No.38/2024.

(ANANDA SEN, J.) R.S./
